facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: improvement notice - critical safeguard at P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3222 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 9 April 2012 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
